canonical_predicate_remap.why: The grant originally minted a NEW normative predicate HOLDS_CAPABILITY (actor -> capability held), which is NOT in the canonical seed predicate vocabulary (fixtures/ontology/canonical-ontology.json). Interning it violates the ZERO-new-symbols invariant. It is remapped to the nearest ACTIVE-VOICE canonical predicate — documented like the orientation-beacon / energy-pen fixtures and consistent with how GUARDED_BY->SAFEGUARDS was handled: the authored intent is preserved as prose, the interned symbol stays canonical, and the empty top-level symbols array plus the shared canonical::grant_fixture_interns_zero_new_symbols test both assert 0 additions on install.

HOLDS_CAPABILITY.note: actor HOLDS_CAPABILITY capability becomes actor USED capability. USED is the canonical generic agent->instrument/capability predicate (an actor wields the capability as its instrument of authority). No direction swap: the edge stays actor(source) -> capability(target), so the bounded reader still materializes each actor's held capability set from its OUTGOING USED edges. No canonical predicate names capability-possession directly; USED is the nearest active-voice fit, chosen the same way construction-toolkit-v0.json mapped CONSTRUCTED_BY->PRODUCES.

content.objective: Grant the capability authority:underground-maintenance to one maintenance actor, and an observe-only capability to one plain citizen, as attributable graph edges a bounded reader can materialize into each actor's held capability set. The grant is DATA only; whether a mutate is admitted is decided by SealedCapabilityPort against the read set, never by this fixture.

content.description: Binds an actor (source) to a capability it holds (target), expressed with the canonical USED predicate (authored intent: HOLDS_CAPABILITY; see the top-level canonical_predicate_remap). This is a USAGE note over an existing canonical predicate, NOT a new predicate definition — it mints no symbol. A bounded local read of an actor's outgoing USED edges to capability targets materializes exactly the capability set that actor holds — nothing more. Holding an observe capability never implies holding a mutate/authority capability; the set is read verbatim and adjudicated elsewhere.

content.note: The exact capability string the Underground sealed hatch (port:l2:mind-universe:underground:sealed-hatch-v0) requires for a mutate. Held only by a maintenance authority, never by an ordinary citizen.
An observe-only capability (the kind a manhole grants). A citizen may hold this and still fail closed at the sealed hatch: observation never widens toward mutation.

content.name: Underground maintenance authority
content.note: Holds authority:underground-maintenance via a canonical USED edge (authored HOLDS_CAPABILITY). The held set is what a bounded read returns; this note is not itself the authority.

content.name: Plain citizen
content.note: Holds only observe; holds NO authority capability. Feeding this actor's read set to the sealed hatch must fail closed, attributably.

content.statement: The maintenance authority was granted authority:underground-maintenance, and the plain citizen was granted observe, by this approved authority fixture. Both grants are attributable to this changeset.

content.justification: The maintenance authority holds authority:underground-maintenance (canonical USED edge; authored HOLDS_CAPABILITY); this is the sole edge that admits an underground mutate at the sealed hatch.

The plain citizen holds observe only (canonical USED edge; authored HOLDS_CAPABILITY). This edge exists to prove the read materializes a non-empty set that still lacks the authority capability, so fail-closed is a real decision, not an empty-set artifact.
